answer.answer: A single power-law slope can in principle be extrapolated across size windows, but pump vs net sampling differ in mesh/filter efficiency, sampled volume, and size-dependent capture, so the two counts are not directly convertible without site-specific slope validation. Any conversion should be treated as a rough estimate, not an exact equivalence.
